rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a change made to text, a file, a website, or code.

example.english: This document still needs one edit.
example.traditional: 呢份文件仲要做一個改動。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 man4 gin2 zung6 jiu3 zou6 jat1 go3 goi2 dung6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for changing written text or the contents of an online file or website.

example.english: I’ll edit the document for you.
example.jyutping: ngo5 bong1 nei5 pin1 zap1 haa5 fan6 man4 gin6

rows.note: Use this specifically when altering or cutting together photographs, sound recordings, or video.

example.english: I need to edit this video now.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 jiu3 zin2 cap1 ni1 dyun6 pin2

rows.note: Use this for an edited media version or cut, rather than a textual change.

example.english: I prefer the edit of this film.
example.traditional: 我比較鍾意呢套戲嘅剪輯版。
example.jyutping: ngo5 bei2 gaau3 zung1 ji3 ni1 tou3 hei3 ge3 zin2 cap1 baan2
